topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I keep thinking about how I've known Mr. Thompson for years, lived next door to him, even. I've seen him take out the trash in his old, faded jeans and t-shirt. He drives a beaten-up sedan, the kind that jars you awake when you're dozing off. But then, there's the whispers at the market, the subtle changes. A car shows up, shiny, no dust on it, fetching him late at night. And the house, it's the same old place, yet I swear the lights are brighter, as if the inside has been completely transformed. I wonder what else I don't know. I’ve always thought I knew my neighbor, but now, I'm not so sure.
